assignments.reason: The sweetening of judgments (המתקת הדינים) belongs by essential nature to the intellect/thought domain. The Torah states explicitly 'כִּי שָׁם שָׁרְשָׁם' — the root of the judgments is in thought, and their sweetening occurs at the level of thought. While causally it is the EFFECT of purity of thought (eitza edge 884), its essential nature — a rectification that operates within the domain of mind/consciousness — places it in the mochin package. It is not a tzaddik-domain concept; it is a thought-domain concept.

This node ('to arrive at pure intellect') is the infinitive/goal-state form of מחין זכים, which is already assigned to Package 1 via the additions file. Its essential nature is identical to מחין זכים — it IS the state of pure intellect, expressed as a destination. The additions analysis noted it as 'effectively a variant label for מחין זכים.' Assigning to Package 1 (mochin domain) by essential nature.

Perfection/completeness of intellect (שלמות למחין) is another expression of the fulfilled state of mochin. The Torah uses it interchangeably with מחין זכים in the same passage: 'אֵין שְׁלֵמוּת לְמֹחִין אֶלָּא עַל־יְדֵי הִתְקַשְּׁרוּת לְצַדִּיקִים.' Its essential nature is intellect in its perfected form — squarely in the mochin domain of Package 1. The additions analysis noted it as 'a variant of מחין זכים.'
